data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_upgrade_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 300 when absent.
- DD2: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_warn_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 600 when absent.

## What to implement
In plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh, extend the existing config-loading block (after the RAW_PATTERNS section, around line 110) to read two new config keys:

```bash
# Size threshold configuration (read once at script init; fall back to hardcoded defaults)
SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES=300
SIZE_WARN_LINES=600
if [[ -n "$READ_CONFIG" ]]; then
    _cfg_upgrade=$("$READ_CONFIG" review.size_upgrade_lines 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    [[ -n "$_cfg_upgrade" && "$_cfg_upgrade" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES="$_cfg_upgrade"
    _cfg_warn=$("$READ_CONFIG" review.size_warn_lines 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    [[ -n "$_cfg_warn" && "$_cfg_warn" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && SIZE_WARN_LINES="$_cfg_warn"
fi
```

Then update _compute_size_action() (around line 704) to use $SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES and $SIZE_WARN_LINES instead of hardcoded 300 and 600:

```bash
_compute_size_action() {
    local diff_size_lines="$1"
    local is_merge="$2"
    if [[ "$is_merge" == "true" ]]; then
        echo "none"
        return
    fi
    if (( diff_size_lines >= SIZE_WARN_LINES )); then
        echo "SIZE_WARNING: ${diff_size_lines}" >&2
        echo "warn"
    elif (( diff_size_lines >= SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES )); then
        echo "upgrade"
    else
        echo "none"
    fi
}
```

IMPORTANT: SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES and SIZE_WARN_LINES are script-scope globals. No need to pass them as parameters. The integer validation ([[ "$_cfg_upgrade" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]) ensures non-numeric config values fall back to defaults.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|FAIL" | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES and SIZE_WARN_LINES globals exist in script init block
  Verify: grep -q 'SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES=300' plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] _compute_size_action uses $SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES and $SIZE_WARN_LINES (not hardcoded 300/600)
  Verify: grep -q 'SIZE_WARN_LINES' plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh && ! grep -c '(( diff_size_lines >= 600 ))' plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config passes (RED → GREEN)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=$(mktemp) && echo 'review.size_upgrade_lines=150' > "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" && bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config.*PASS'
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config passes (RED → GREEN)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=$(mktemp) && echo 'review.size_warn_lines=400' > "$WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE" && bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config.*PASS'
- [ ] Existing size_action tests still pass (defaults unchanged)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep -E 'test_classifier_size_action.*PASS' | wc -l | grep -qE '^[4-9]'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement config-driven SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES/SIZE_WARN_LINES in review-complexity-classifier.sh
